source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Focusing mainly on medication adherence during each scheduled clinic visit, with comparatively little attention paid to the client's broader emotional and psychosocial needs","B":"A single conversation held once at the time of initial diagnosis, with fairly little planned follow-up offered to the client in the months and years afterward","C":"Assuming the client needs fairly little ongoing psychosocial support once they become medically stable on their current respiratory treatment plan","D":"Providing ongoing emotional support, connecting the client with helpful resources, and addressing the unique challenges of managing a chronic, potentially progressive respiratory condition over time"}}
source_row.rationale: Supporting a client's psychological adjustment to chronic respiratory disease includes providing ongoing emotional support, connecting them with relevant resources (such as pulmonary rehabilitation or support groups), and addressing the unique challenges of managing a chronic, potentially progressive condition, recognizing this adjustment process continues throughout the disease course.
source_row.source_detail: Comprehensive Support for Chronic Respiratory Disease Adjustment
source_row.source_name: American Thoracic Society — Psychosocial Support in Chronic Respiratory Disease
